paragraphs: The Indian American Artists Association (IAAA) is a 501(c)(3) entity whose purpose is to provide fund-raising and financial support for the arts programs, to promote and uplift Indian American artists, their art activities, and to raise community awareness of the Indian arts through art education.

sections.heading: Members
paragraphs: Membership eligibility encompasses self-identified visual artists from the Indian subcontinent who work in 2D/3D mediums including painting, sketching, sculpture, digital art, photography, video art or mixed media and support IAAA's goals.

sections.heading: Your art has a story. Find the community that helps it travel further.
paragraphs: Join a growing network of Indian-origin visual artists creating, exhibiting, and building community across the United States.
